description: This file defines a QuestionGeneratorAgent class that uses a state machine workflow to generate questions, including methods for single and batch question generation, with validation and conditional regeneration logic. It also defines a QuestionState TypedDict for the workflow state schema.

classes.name: QuestionState
classes.description: State schema for the question generation workflow, defining the structure of the state dictionary used in the process.

classes.name: QuestionGeneratorAgent
classes.description: An agent class that manages question generation workflows using a state graph, including methods for generating single questions and batches with validation and conditional logic.

methods.name: _build_graph
methods.description: Constructs the question generation workflow graph with nodes and edges, including conditional edges for regeneration.

methods.name: _should_regenerate
methods.description: Decision function that determines whether to regenerate a question based on validation results and attempt count.

methods.name: generate_single_question
methods.description: Asynchronously generates a single question based on chapter ID, difficulty, and image inclusion, returning the question or None.

methods.name: generate_batch_questions
methods.description: Asynchronously generates multiple questions in batches, managing concurrency and filtering out failed attempts.
